test_lit_list_input: test pl.lit with list input to create a literal column from a Python list
test_lit_tuple_input: test pl.lit with tuple input to create a literal column from a Python tuple
test_lit_numpy_array_input: test pl.lit with numpy array input to create a literal column from a numpy array
test_lit_int_return_type: test pl.lit integer input to verify correct dtype inference for int32 and int64 ranges
test_lit_decimal: test pl.lit with Decimal input to create a literal column with Decimal dtype
test_lit_enum_input: test pl.lit with enum input to create a literal column from Python enum values
test_lit_structs: test pl.lit with dict input to create a literal column from a Python struct/dict
test_lit_string_float: test pl.lit with float value and dtype Utf8 to create a string literal from a float
test_lit_object_type: test pl.lit with time object and dtype Object to create a literal column from a Python object
test_lit_unsupported_type: test pl.lit with unsupported type LazyFrame to verify TypeError is raised
